name: phystack-template-edge-python-cuda
description: PhyStack Edge App Template (CUDA / GPU Python)

scripts.schema: mkdir -p build && bunx ts-schema src/schema.ts build/
scripts.build: bun run schema && cp -r src/*.py build/ && cp requirements.txt build/ && touch build/index.html
scripts.pub: bun run build && phy app build create $npm_package_name --dir . --push --publish
